outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of MRI in predicting abnormal invasive placentation
Correlation between MRI findings and intraoperative findings
cohort: 27 pregnant women with clinically or sonographically suspected PAD and having major risk factors of PAD (previous lower segment caesarean section and placenta previa in the current pregnancy).
finding: Prenatal MRI demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy in detecting PADs, particularly in high-risk patients.
